source: Quiz 5 - Sessions 1-6: Model Training, Alignment, and the Agent Harness
question: Why should you check which skill version is included when an agent packages your work?

options.text: A skill version establishes whether the model has more parameters
options.feedback: Skill versions concern changes to instructions and resources. They are not versions of the model's learned parameter arrays.

options.text: A skill version determines whether the output needs inspection
options.feedback: The verification habit applies to the actual output regardless of the version label. A label cannot substitute for checking its contents.

options.text: A skill version replaces the need to state required contents
options.feedback: A version can identify intended guidance, but the agent still needs the required contents and output format when assembling the deliverable.

options.text: A readable package may include an outdated procedure
options.feedback: Readability does not establish that the intended materials were gathered. The notes specifically call for checking explanations, results, and intended skill versions.
